seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player A1-4: set cap, move 4 unless bounds/wall/box/chaser block; idle box ahead of cap = faced; A5 faced<->grabbed; grabbed box moves with player (may enter wall).
Chaser every step: release seated carried box > pick up free box whose right side it touches > greedy x-first 4-step toward nearest pickup point (box.x+4,box.y) or nearest empty slot (+4,0) when carrying; y if x blocked.
Carried box landing on an empty slot -> seated tag, slot filled; box border colour by state (idle4/carried5/faced3/grabbed0), names box_i by (y,x).
Wall = period-4 dither masked by layer>0 objects; tray/slots geometry static.
Unconfirmed: pulling a grabbed box backwards, chaser behaviour at the wall (boxes left of it), ties between equidistant goals.
